---
type: parens
title: 'Make $2 + 3 \cdot 4$ equal $20$'
expression: 2 + 3 · 4
target: "20"
---

Tap a gap to place **(**, then a gap to its right to place **)**. Put one pair of parentheses in so that it equals $20$.

## Hint
Without parentheses, multiplication comes first: $2 + 3 \cdot 4 = 2 + 12 = 14$. Which part should be done first instead?

## Solution
**Answer:** $(2 + 3) \cdot 4$

Parentheses are done first: $(2 + 3) \cdot 4 = 5 \cdot 4 = 20$.
